claims.assertion: 先烧釉下青花，再填釉上彩并较低温度复烧。
claims.quote: The cobalt-blue design, drawn on the vessel before glazing, was fired at a high temperature. The images were then filled in with overglaze enamel pigments, which were fired again—this time at a lower temperature
